text:
An ice cube of mass 12g at 0°C absorbs thermal energy from the surroundings at a rate of 3J/s.
The specific latent heat of fusion of ice is 330J/g.
How long will it take for the ice cube to melt?
A
82.5s
B
1320s
C
3960s
D
11880s
subject: Physics
